# Raytube project architecture

Raytube casts a 2015 MacBook Pro running Omarchy (Arch + Hyprland) to the
family TVs: the **Office TV** (Apple TV 4K, AirPlay) and the downstairs
**Chromecast HD** (Chromecast with Google TV HD, Cast Streaming). It can
mirror the laptop screen, or cast a separate **virtual TV desktop** that holds
scenes (a family board, a TV browser, any window) with layouts and rotation.

The project is a set of small scripts in the repo root that drive three
patched upstream programs cloned under `project-references/`. There is no
server, database or build of our own beyond those patched programs.

## Goals and constraints

- **Keep the CPU free and let the GPUs do pixel work.** The CPU is a
  4-core Haswell that thermally throttles; the whole design follows from that.
- **Never use the AMD GPU's video encoder (VCE).** It hard-crashed the
  display on 2026-09-23. Encode on the Intel iGPU (`/dev/dri/renderD129`).
  See [hardware-and-platform.md](hardware-and-platform.md#amd-gpu-vce-encoder-crash).
- **Low latency and readable text** on the TV, controllable from the Omarchy
  Display bar menu and hotkeys.

## Devices on the LAN

| Name | Model | IP | Protocol | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Office TV | Apple TV 4K (AppleTV6,2), tvOS 26.6 | <apple-tv-ip> | AirPlay 2 (doubletake) | Paired (`~/.config/doubletake/credentials.json`). Asks for 1280x720@30; sent 1080p by default, sound delay 50 ms |
| Chromecast HD | Chromecast with Google TV (HD), Cast fw 3.72 | <chromecast-ip> | Cast Streaming (omacast) | 1080p60 max, not 4K |
| Computer Monitor | LG OLED42C2 | <lg-tv-ip> | AirPlay + Cast | Unpaired, untested |

## Components

```
Display menu (nathank.monitor) ─┐
Hotkeys (bindings.lua) ─────────┼─► raytube-cast ──► cast-tv.sh ──► cast-guard.sh ──► doubletake ─► Office TV
                                │        │                                    (AirPlay)
                                │        └──────► cast-chromecast.sh ─► cast-guard.sh ─► omacast ─► Chromecast
                                │                                                  (Cast Streaming)
                                │  cast-watch.sh (unit raytube-watch): logs errors/xruns, raises the audio
                                │  cycle, runs `raytube-cast resync` after audio trouble
                                └─► raytube-tv ─► Hyprland (headless "TV" output, scenes, layouts)
                                         │           board (Chromium), TV browser (Firefox)
                                         └─► raytube-media.py ─► TV browser (BiDi) / Chromecast apps (pychromecast)

Video source for both TVs: wf-recorder (patched) ─ screencopy DMA-BUF ─► Intel VA-API H.264
```

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `raytube-cast` | Front door: `list` receivers (AirPlay + Cast), `start`/`stop`/`toggle`/`status`, `mode mirror\|desktop`, `tv` (TV mode O), `release`, `size` (AirPlay picture size), `av-delay` / `av-delay-step` (sound delay), `resync`. Runs casts as the systemd user unit `raytube-cast` (`CPUWeight=1000`) and sets a 1024-sample PipeWire cycle while casting |
| `raytube-tv` | Virtual TV desktop: headless output, `send`/`to-tv`/`back`/`home`, scenes, layouts, rotation, board, TV browser, `video-full`, native YouTube, `pull`, TV mode (`tv-mode`, `key`) |
| `raytube-media.py` | Helper run via `uv`: WebDriver BiDi to the TV browser (`tv-video`, `tv-pause`, `tv-open`, `tv-fullscreen`), pychromecast to the Chromecast's own apps (`cc-status`, `cc-youtube`, `cc-quit`) |
| `cast-tv.sh` | AirPlay launcher: doubletake with the zero-copy capture, auto-restart loop on stream errors |
| `cast-chromecast.sh` | Chromecast launcher: fresh omacast daemon, start, stay alive while casting |
| `cast-guard.sh` | Thermal guard wrapped around every cast: quiet fan curve, turbo off, CPU cap, abort |
| `wf-capture.sh` | omacast's `video_command`: patched wf-recorder, optional `-o TV` |
| `cast-watch.sh` | Watchdog (transient unit `raytube-watch`, started by hand): logs cast errors and audio xruns with context, raises the audio cycle to 2048, re-syncs the TV after audio trouble |
| `sync-watch.sh` | Per-minute fps / source age / slack summary (unit `raytube-syncwatch`); needs a `-debug` cast |
| `cc-selftest.sh` | Chromecast self-test from receiver RTCP feedback (no one watching needed) |
| `board/` | Family board page (three.js, vendored; calendar panel) and `data.js` (mock data) |
| `latency-test.html` | Reaction-time page to measure glass-to-glass latency |
| `av-sync-test.html` | Flash + beep every 4 s, to judge sound/picture sync on the TV |
| `design/cast-surfaces.html` | Design mockups for the casting surfaces |
| `patches/` | Our changes to doubletake, wf-recorder and omacast, with base commits |
| `WISHLIST.md` | Parked ideas |

## Configuration and state (the "schema")

| Path | Written by | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `~/.config/omacast/config.toml` | us | Chromecast defaults: device, preset (1080p30), 8000 kbps, audio, `video_command = wf-capture.sh` |
| `~/.config/doubletake/credentials.json` | doubletake | AirPlay pairing keyed by device id |
| `~/.config/raytube/tv.json` | raytube-tv | Scenes: `id`, `label`, `rotate`, `seconds`, `layout` (defaults 120/120/300 s; currently 15 s for testing, backup in `tv.json.before-test`, T-3) |
| `~/.config/raytube/airplay-size/<ip>` | raytube-cast `size`, Display menu | Picture size sent to that Apple TV in both modes; absent = `1920x1080` |
| `~/.config/raytube/av-delay/<ip>` | raytube-cast `av-delay[-step]`, Display menu | Sound delay in ms, re-read live by doubletake (Office TV: `50`) |
| `~/.local/state/raytube/tv-state.json` | raytube-tv | Per-scene main window and layout, sent-window stack, rotation next time |
| `~/.local/state/raytube/tv-size` | raytube-tv `up` | TV desktop size; read by `monitors.lua` and `wf-capture.sh` |
| `~/.local/state/raytube/mode` | raytube-cast | `mirror` or `desktop` |
| `~/.local/state/raytube/last-receiver` | raytube-cast | `ip<TAB>name` for the TV-mode O (on/off) toggle and `pull` |
| `~/.local/state/raytube/native.json` | raytube-tv | Set while a video plays in the Chromecast's own YouTube app |
| `~/.local/state/raytube/thermal.log` | cast-guard.sh | Temperatures, fan and CPU-cap events |
| `~/.local/state/raytube/cast-watch.log` | cast-watch.sh | Cast errors, audio xruns and re-syncs, with CPU/temperature context |
| `~/.local/state/raytube/sync-watch.log` | sync-watch.sh | Per-minute video timing summary |
| `~/.local/state/display-flip` | `display-flip` (⌘⌥R) | `2` when the laptop panel is flipped for the bed mount; the TV then sits below the laptop |
| `~/.local/share/raytube/tv-firefox/` | raytube-tv `browser` | TV browser profile (`user.js`, `.raytube-pid`) |
| `~/.local/share/raytube/board-chromium/` | raytube-tv `board` | Board Chromium profile |
| `~/.local/state/omacast/omacastd.log` | omacast | Session log incl. `receiver:` telemetry lines |
| `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/raytube-cast.target` | raytube-cast | `ip<TAB>name` of the running cast |
| PipeWire `settings` metadata `clock.force-quantum` | raytube-cast, cast-watch.sh | 1024 while casting (2048 after glitches), cleared on stop |

## Desktop integration

- **Display menu:** Omarchy plugin clone `~/.config/omarchy/plugins/nathank.monitor`
  (CAST: Screen / TV desktop chips, receiver list; for an Apple TV also Sound sync − / +,
  720p / 1080p / 1440p and Re-sync TV; TV DESKTOP section).
- **Bar:** Omarchy's built-in `omarchy.bar` is the active bar, and it **still shows on
  the TV**. The clone `nathank.bar` (hid the bar on `TV`) is installed but disabled:
  Omarchy gives cloned bars no plugin services, so bar widgets like OmaStats show
  nothing in them. Keeping the bar off the TV by cropping the capture is T-24, not
  built yet (see [tv-desktop.md](tv-desktop.md#the-tv-output)).
- **Hotkeys:** `~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua`: ⌘⌃↑ / ⌘⌃↓ and ⌘⇧T TV mode (see [tv-desktop.md](tv-desktop.md#hotkeys)).
- **Monitor rule:** `~/.config/hypr/monitors.lua` keeps the `TV` output at the size in `~/.local/state/raytube/tv-size`, 30 Hz, centred above the laptop (`auto-center-up`; below it, `auto-center-down`, when the panel is flipped).
- **Firewall:** UFW allows UDP 319/320 from the Apple TV (PTP timing).
